question: If the radii of two circles are 7 cm and 4 cm and the length of the transverse common tangent is 13 cm, then the distance between the two centres is:
solution:
Given:

Radii are 7 cm and 4 cm

The length of the transverse common tangent = 13 cm

Formula used:

Length of transverse common tangent = √(d² - (r₁ + r₂)²)

Where d = distance between their centers

r₁ and r₂ are radii of circles

Calculation:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a0122c776637e2c56adf0c102057aadebd46c1d0e38cee426b78859792a23c9.png] 

PA = 7

QB = 4

PQ = 13

Length of transverse common tangent = √(d2 - (7 + 4)2)

⇒ 13 = √d² - 11² 

⇒ 169 = d² - 121 

⇒ d² = 290

⇒ d = √290

∴ T**he distance between the two centres** is √290 cm.
